comment: The guidance places strong emphasis on centrally planned architecture and governance as the primary driver of digital transformation. In practice, many successful digital health capabilities emerge through locally implemented solutions that are subsequently standardised and scaled once value has been demonstrated.

public.text: The guidance places strong emphasis on centrally planned architecture and governance as the primary driver of digital transformation. In practice, many successful digital health capabilities emerge through locally implemented solutions that are subsequently standardised and scaled once value has been demonstrated.
public.suggestedRevision: Add an explicit implementation-led pathway that recognises local innovation, pilot deployments and operational validation as legitimate entry points for DPI-H adoption. The reference architecture should position itself as a framework for documenting, assessing and scaling proven implementations, rather than implying that transformation must begin with central architectural design.
